crossRefs.note: For Yahweh has a day of vengeance, a year of recompense for the cause of Zion.
According to their deeds, he will repay as appropriate, wrath to his adversaries, recompense to his enemies; he will…
who say, ‘Stay by yourself, don’t come near to me, for I am holier than you.’ These are smoke in my nose, a fire that…
Behold, I will stir them up out of the place where you have sold them, and will return your repayment on your own head;
He said: “Yahweh will roar from Zion, and utter his voice from Jerusalem; and the pastures of the shepherds will mourn…

translations.web: A voice of tumult from the city, a voice from the temple, a voice of Yahweh that repays his enemies what they deserve.
translations.bsb: Hear the uproar from the city; listen to the voice from the temple! It is the voice of the LORD, repaying His enemies what they deserve!
translations.kjv: A voice of noise from the city, a voice from the temple, a voice of the LORD that rendereth recompence to his enemies.
translations.asv: A voice of tumult from the city, a voice from the temple, a voice of Jehovah that rendereth recompense to his enemies.
